column1: # CMDR tool-install recipe registry — one row per binary.
# Consumed by contrib/cmdr-install-tool.sh to install a missing tool that a
# stored command invokes. Tab-separated. '-' means "no recipe for this method".
# cols:  binary   brew_formula   go_module   pipx_pkg   apt_pkg   note
# Method preference is chosen by the installer per-platform (macOS: brew > go >
# pipx; Linux: apt > go > pipx), filtered to methods that both have a recipe
# here AND whose toolchain is installed. Add a row to teach it a new tool.
# NOTE: the `httpx` brew/go recipe is ProjectDiscovery's HTTP toolkit, NOT the
# Python `httpx` HTTP client (which is `pip install httpx`). Don't "fix" it.
# --- Common web/fuzzing tools (handy beyond the recon pack) ---
